$description: Semantic color tokens. Light-mode values; dark overrides in color-dark.tokens.json. Ported from web/src/app.css :root block — do not drop or rename without reason.

background.$description: Page background: a cool off-white, so white cards read as raised without a shadow. One fill for the whole canvas; separation comes from spacing and thin borders.

muted.$description: Muted surface fill (same as secondary in light).

destructive-foreground.$description: Text/icon on a filled destructive surface.

destructive-strong.$description: Destructive text on the page background or a destructive tint, where the action color falls short of 4.5:1.

input.$description: Input border/fill color. Dark enough (3.1:1 on the page and on cards) that a field's edge identifies it as a control (WCAG 1.4.11); at 0.93 it measured 1.2:1 and empty fields vanished into the page.

ring.$description: Focus ring color: the brand fill, which clears 3:1 against every light surface (WCAG 1.4.11). brand-ring is too pale for a focus indicator on the page background (1.9:1).

brand.$description: Brand CTA fill — Keenu indigo. Clears 4.5:1 for its foreground and 3:1 against every light surface, which is why it also serves as the focus ring.

brand-strong.$description: Darker brand tone for readable text/links.

brand-muted.$description: Soft indigo tint for chips, badges and highlighted rows.

brand-ring.$description: Focus outline color on brand surfaces.

warning.$description: Caution fill. The solid block that marks something as needing attention.

warning-strong.$description: Caution text and borders on the page background, where the fill is not legible.

warning-muted.$description: Soft caution tint. A background that carries the meaning without the weight.

success.$description: Success fill: a gain, a pass, a connected state. The solid block.

success-strong.$description: Success text and borders on the page (6.0:1) and on the success tint (5.3:1).

success-muted.$description: Soft success tint behind success-strong text.
